extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers for the Yale Journal of Biology and Medicine (YJBM)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for YJBM peer reviewers on how to prepare and submit reviews, including submission platform, timeline expectations, required review components, and conflict-of-interest definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission platform (Scholastica)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews are submitted through Scholastica; reviewers create a free Scholastica account; manuscript and supporting docs are kept there.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Scholastica to access the manuscript and to submit your review. Create a free account if you do not already have one; all materials and the review exchange occur on that platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit reviews 1–2 weeks after receipt of the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot meet the deadline, contact editors before it expires so they can reassign the review or warn the authors. Timely communication is required rather than missing the deadline silently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of competing interests
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement of any competing interests is a required component of the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare any potential conflicts in the designated place (comments to the editors). This is a required part of the review submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section for editors (confidential concerns / reviewer ability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a section for the editor with concerns about the manuscript or your ability to review it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this private/editor-directed section to report anything that should not be shared with authors — e.g., methodological concerns you want the editor to weigh, or reasons you may not be the right reviewer (competence issues, conflicts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments to authors and reviewer confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments to authors are sent to the author directly; reviewer identity is kept confidential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write comments to authors understanding they will receive them directly. Do not include identifying information in author-directed comments; maintain confidentiality of your identity as the reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict-of-interest definitions (YJBM-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: A reviewer has a competing interest if they: are a direct competitor; dislike a specific author or topic; or may profit from the publication of a specific manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any of these situations apply, state the competing interest in the comments to the editors. When in doubt, disclose the relationship so the editor can decide whether reassignment or other action is necessary.
